user.title: CozyLife account
user.description: Sign in once so Home Assistant can read your device's control key and its assigned cloud relay. Your password is used for this single request and is not saved.

address.title: Device address
address.description: {device} did not answer discovery on this network. Enter its local IP address, or cancel, switch the device on and try again.

error.invalid_auth: That email address and password were not accepted by CozyLife.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach CozyLife. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: That device is already set up.
abort.no_devices: This CozyLife account has no devices on it.

init.title: CozyLife options
init.description: Polling the device's local listener more often appears to bring on the firmware fault this integration works around, so a slow interval is deliberate.
